nodes.title: Help❓
widgets_values:
CONTROLNET:
🔹 ControlNet extracts info from an image and uses it to guide the diffusion process.
🔹 A preprocessor prepares an image so the ControlNet can extract the right information.
🔹 This group sends up to one  helper (4️⃣) to two groups.
🔹 The helper (4️⃣) can be saved and re-used by disabling the preprocessor toggle.
🔹 The top row (blue) sends to the "Generate" group.
🔹 The bottom row (pale blue) sends to the "Redraw" group.

IPADAPTER:
🔹 Image-prompt adapter (IPA) uses an image as a prompt.
🔹 The attention mask (0️⃣) can  limit the IPA to masked parts of the image. To use: generate an image ➜ right click it ➜ Copy (Clipspace) ➜ right click attention mask (0️⃣) ➜ Paste (Clipspace) ➜ right click attention mask (0️⃣) ➜ Open in MaskEditor ➜ mask target area ➜ reuse seed ➜ run again.
🔹 This group allows up to two IPAs at the same time.
🔹 The top row (blue) prompts the "Generate" group.
🔹 The bottom row (pale blue) prompts the "Redraw" group.

nodes.title: Help❓
widgets_values:
🔹 This group does text-to-image generation and holds the loop image (♾️).
🔹 (2️⃣) is a group node that combines the checkpoint loader, empty latent, and clip skip.
🔹 The 'Refresh Group' toggle makes ComfyUI re-validate the graph when you run.
🔹 The ControlNet and IPAdapter toggles block both groups even if those groups are active.
🔹 The ControlNet (1️⃣) model should match the preprocessor that was used to create the helper image, and the base model (SD1.5/SDXL) of the checkpoint you are using.
🔹 Enabling the 'Loop Toggle' makes the group output the image stored in the 'Loop Image' (♾️) node.

nodes.title: Help❓
widgets_values:
🔹 This group can remove a background, draw a new background (for transparent images), or outpaint.
🔹 (1️⃣) is a group node that combines the checkpoint loader, prescaler, and clip skip.
🔹 The image can be padded (2️⃣) using any function, but it is mainly used for outpainting (🖼️).
🔹 The threshold (3️⃣) sets how aggressively the background is removed.
🔹 If this group is used alone, 'Load Image' (0️⃣) is used as the input.
🔹 To send the output to 'Loop Image' (♾️): reuse seed ➜ enable "Send to Start" (🏠︎) ➜ run.

nodes.title: Help❓
widgets_values:
🔹 This group does image-to-image generation.
🔹 (2️⃣) is a group node that combines the checkpoint loader, prescaler, and clip skip.
🔹 The 'Refresh Group' toggle makes ComfyUI re-validate the graph when you run.
🔹 The ControlNet and IPAdapter toggles block both groups even if those groups are active.
🔹 The ControlNet (1️⃣) model should match the preprocessor that was used to create the helper image, and the base model (SD1.5/SDXL) of the checkpoint you are using.
🔹 If this group is used alone, load image (0️⃣) is used as the input.
🔹 To send the output to 'Loop Image' (♾️): reuse seed ➜ enable "Send to Start" (🏠︎) ➜ run.

nodes.title: Help❓
widgets_values:
🔹 This group does inpainting with a cropped or full context area.
🔹 (1️⃣) is a group node that combines the checkpoint loader, prescaler, and clip skip.
🔹 Run to populate the mask nodes (2️⃣). These nodes can stop execution if there is no mask by using the 'block' widget.
🔹 Context mask (2️⃣) is only used with crop & stitch (✂️). It lets you draw the boundaries of the context area (6️⃣) to let the model "see more" while inpainting. It can also be disabled.
🔹 Context area (6️⃣) shows what the model is seeing.
🔹 To adjust the crop settings, open the Crop (⚙️) node.
🔹 If this group is used alone, load image (0️⃣) is used as the input.
🔹 To send the output to 'Loop Image' (♾️): reuse seed ➜ enable "Send to Start" (🏠︎) ➜ run.

nodes.title: Help❓
widgets_values:
🔹 This group does face detailing or swapping.
🔹 (1️⃣) is a group node that combines the checkpoint loader, prescaler, and clip skip.
🔹 Indexes (3️⃣,4️⃣) let you swap multiple faces. 0 is the largest face, 'n' is the smallest. Original indexes (3️⃣) are for the loaded image (2️⃣), swap indexes (4️⃣) are for the target.
🔹 The detailer (5️⃣) needs a face detection model (bbox) & segmentation model (sam). It works by cropping the face, upscaling it to the 'size' provided, and redrawing it.
🔹 To adjust the parameters/models used by both functions, open the settings (⚙️) nodes.
🔹 If this group is used alone, load image (0️⃣) is used as the input.
🔹 To send the output to 'Loop Image' (♾️): reuse seed ➜ enable "Send to Start" (🏠︎) ➜ run.

nodes.title: Help❓
widgets_values:
🔹 This group does model or tiled upscaling.
🔹 (1️⃣) is a group node that combines the checkpoint loader, prescaler, and clip skip.
🔹 The upscale model (2️⃣) and final downscale (6️⃣) apply to both functions.
🔹 The 'Save' toggle lets you choose whether to automatically save the output.
🔹 The 'Refresh Group' toggle makes ComfyUI re-validate the graph when you run.
🔹 If this group is used alone, load image (0️⃣) is used as the input.
🔹 To send the output to 'Loop Image' (♾️): reuse seed ➜ enable "Send to Start" (🏠︎) ➜ run.

nodes.title: START HERE 🔔
widgets_values:
OVERVIEW:
🔹 This workflow is designed for checkpoint (safetensors) models.
🔹 There are 8 color-coded groups. Help nodes (❓) tell you more about their functionality.
🔹 Each group (except IPAdapter) is a self-contained workflow with an input & output.
🔹 Yellowish-brown toggles are options that let you change the functions of each group.
🔹 Nodes in each group are numbered (1️⃣,2️⃣,3️⃣) for readability.
🔹 Group toggles (🌐) in the top-right let you turn off any group.
🔹 The image from the first active group is sent to the next active group, left-to-right.
🔹 Send toggles (🏠︎) will save the output image in the Generate group's loop image (♾️).
🔹 Activate the loop toggle to use the loop image (♾️) as the output of the Generate group.
🔹 Bookmarks (🔖) let you use the 1-8 keys to jump to each group. You can adjust the zoom level of the bookmark by clicking the grey circle (🔘) to maximize it.
🔹 Missing node packs can be downloaded from the dependencies below or the Manager.
🔹 Missing models can be downloaded from the resources below or the Manager.

ERRORS:
🪳 [Errno 2] No such file or directory (last image was deleted or moved)
🔧 Select a different image in the given node.
🪳 Allocation on device (exhausted gpu vram)
🔧 Unload models (Manager) or allow each group to finish before running the next.
🪳 InpaintCrop Batch size of optional_context_masks must be the same as images or None
🔧 Disable the context mask toggle.
🪳 'NoneType' object is not subscriptable (mute conflicts -> missing inputs)
🪳 Changing ControlNet settings does not re-run KSampler (Inefficient KSampler)
🪳 A node is running when it shouldn't be (UncomfyUI)
🔧 Use the 'Refresh Group' toggle.
